title: EmeraldBag
description: A wearable emerald pouch that automatically collects and stores emeralds while displaying the current amount on the HUD.
body:
Tired of picking up emeralds one by one? This mod fixes that. Add a wearable emerald pouch that automatically collects all emeralds dropped on the ground and stores them in a single-slot container. No micromanagement, no clutter—just smooth progression. When equipped via Curios, the pouch also displays a live HUD counter with your total stored emeralds, so you always know exactly how rich you are at a glance. Built specifically for the DungeonsUnleashed modpack, this mod is designed to fit into economy-driven progression systems while keeping inventory management clean and effortless. Features Auto-collect emeralds from the ground instantly Compact single-slot storage system Clean UI to deposit and withdraw emeralds Live HUD counter while equipped Curios compatibility required Lightweight, no performance overhead Why it exists Because picking up loot manually is outdated. This mod is meant for modpacks where emeralds actually matter—whether as currency, progression, or trading power. It removes friction and keeps the focus on gameplay, not inventory spam. How it works Equip the pouch in your Curios slot. From that moment on, any emerald that drops near you is automatically absorbed into the pouch. Open the interface anytime to manage your storage, or just check the HUD to see your total instantly. Requirements Requires Curios API Designed for Minecraft modpacks using Curios equipment systems Compatibility Built for DungeonsUnleashed modpack Safe for most modpacks Lightweight and optimized No known conflicts
